name: orbitstage-live
description: A safe, local-first Windows control room and 9:16 stage for TikTok LIVE.
author: OrbitStage contributors

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -s first -n control,stage,desktop -c cyan,magenta,yellow "npm run dev -w @orbitstage/control" "npm run dev -w @orbitstage/stage" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:5173 tcp:127.0.0.1:5174 && npm run dev -w @orbitstage/desktop"
scripts.build: npm run assets:check && npm run build -w @orbitstage/shared && npm run build -w @orbitstage/live-service && npm run build -w @orbitstage/control && npm run build -w @orbitstage/stage && npm run build -w @orbitstage/desktop
scripts.lint: npm run assets:check && npm run typecheck
scripts.release:verify: npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.start: npm run build && cross-env ORBITSTAGE_DEV=0 electron apps/desktop/dist/main.cjs
